markets.rules_primary: If Natalie Harp leaves (or announces she will leave) as Special Assistant and Executive Assistant to the President before Dec 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
This market resolves based on when the departure is publicly announced or officially communicated, regardless of the effective date.

Natalie Harp holds both of these titles at the same time. She counts as having left only if she ceases to hold all White House staff positions. Moving to a different title or role inside the White House does not count.

This market resolves on a departure announced by Natalie Harp or by the White House, or on a listed source agency reporting that such an announcement has been made or confirmed.
